methodology: Disclosed corrected re-score of the frozen 6 Nov 2026 run (12 traps x 5 providers, 60 rows). Same raw answers, re-scored with the fixed shared normaliser (traptest/normalise.py: Decimal ETH -> wei including scientific notation '1e-05', hex, '100.0') and the canonical scorer (traptest/scoring.py: value as Decimal, block as int). Strict original preserved verbatim under 'strict_original'. F-normalise: Truvian t08 was scored FAIL though its value_eth 1e-05 equals the expected 10000000000000 wei; corrected Truvian is 4/12. F-token: t03/t04 score the Transfer EVENT amount as value, which no provider returns in value_eth (native tx value); the frozen traps are untouched and a value-excluded view (status/from/to/block only) is shown alongside — no provider passes t03/t04 even value-excluded, so it changes no pass count. This file is a re-analysis; it does NOT change the live results.
